decisions.reason: The fifteen-day program needs little dedicated investment and supports the announced fast-response positioning, so management keeps it despite its overlap with the broader express line D.
Sustaining the seventy-two-hour promise is costly, but it is a visible commitment to fast delivery, and management attributes weak uptake to temporary market conditions.
The multi-model express line has its own web page and anchors the firm's publicly announced fast-delivery strategy, so the firm persists with it.
The digital platform carries substantial sunk development costs and is central to the announced service direction, so shortfalls are treated as start-up difficulties.
Although C was withdrawn, the fire and smoke protection door belongs to the certified core safety portfolio, and its approval investment favors keeping it.
